headline: Public hearings on license applications for Caliente Mexican Grill, 295 Armistice Boulevard, and Nevermore, 65 Blackstone Avenue.
summary: The agenda includes public hearings on two Class B victualler licenses and petitions for several other licenses. It also includes a report on Tiki's Auto Sales and a bazaar permit for St. Mary's Antiochian Orthodox Church.
items: Petition for Luzitania Bakery victualling house first class renewal, 312 Barton St. (LIC#VIC-24-156)
Petition for Urban Crave Halal Grill victualling house first class new license, 424 Benefit St. (LIC#VIC-26-22)
Bond approval for Fastcash Pawn & Checkcashers, Inc. and Fry Business Holdings, Inc. pawn broker renewal, surety Western Surety Company
Public hearing on Caliente Mexican Grill Class B (victualler) new license, 295 Armistice Boulevard (LIC#LQB-26-11)
Public hearing on Nevermore Class B (victualler) new license, 65 Blackstone Avenue (LIC#LQB-26-12)
Petition for Nevermore victualling house first class new license, 65 Blackstone Avenue (LIC#LQB-26-12)
Report from Carl J. Johnson, Director of Zoning and Code Enforcement, on Tiki's Auto Sales inspection report from September 17, 2026

Second update on Tiki's Auto Sales Annex (RZG Inc.), 772 Main St. (LIC#AUT-24-68), with four stipulations: no mechanical repairs in front of the building; no debris in the back; all work inside the building; all vehicles in front for sale only
Kennel renewal for Harmony (Harmony Dog Training LLC), 65 Patterson Ave. (LIC#KNL-25-2), postponed at earlier meetings
Petition for entertainment and Class F (beer & wine) license for St. Mary's Antiochian Orthodox Church annual holiday bazaar at 60 St. Mary Way, November 6 to 8, 2026 (LIC#EVT-26-87)
location: First Floor City Council Chambers, Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street
